packageType: unsigned on-disk folder bundle (publish output + metadata + SHA-256 manifests); no installer package
releaseStatus: internal development and testing build. Not commercially ready; not for end-user distribution.

reproducibility.identityBoundAtBundleTime: identity.txt / bundle.json record HEAD + git status/diff hashes; a bundle is only meaningful against the recorded source snapshot

localInstallUpdate.packageStatus: LOCAL-ONLY / UNSIGNED DEVELOPMENT: local install/update/rollback skeleton; no code signing, no network update, no diagnostics upload, no cloud/mobile/ads/credits; not commercially ready
localInstallUpdate.signing: unsigned (no Authenticode/catalog; bundle integrity via SHA-256 manifest recomputation only)
localInstallUpdate.updateChannel: none; local on-disk bundles only (versionId = <release-metadata.version>-<bundle.json.diffHash first 8 hex>)
localInstallUpdate.rollback: atomic active.json pointer swap (same-volume tmp write + File.Replace); failed installs roll back staging and keep the previous pointer; previously installed versions are never deleted
localInstallUpdate.writeBoundary: all writes stay inside the explicitly passed -InstallRoot validated by the publication boundary guard before any write; bundle directory is read-only input

exitCodes.2: operation failure (manifest hash mismatch / bundle verification failed / copy or re-verify failed / pointer switch failed - already rolled back)

dataMigration.contract: legacy Node data -> .NET data directory migration; explicit -Source/-Dest required (no default real paths); default DryRun (plan only: no directory creation, no copy, no file-content reads, no real-data statistics); real copy only with explicit -Apply
dataMigration.pathSafety: source and dest path chains validated via tools/_publication-guard.ps1: per-level realpath, junction/symlink refusal, UNC/'..' refusal, whole-tree reparse audit of source and existing dest, source/dest overlap refusal; dest protected roots = source repo + system directories (user profile intentionally not a migration protected root: data legitimately lives there; safety comes from explicit paths + default DryRun + explicit -Apply)
dataMigration.conflictPolicy: non-empty dest refused (exit 4) without explicit -MergeExisting; robocopy /XO never overwrites newer dest files; any expected file missing/size-mismatch/hash-mismatch after copy exits 2 (conflict-dest-newer when dest is newer); port rewrite (optional -Port) failure exits 2
dataMigration.manifest: pre-flight SHA-256 inventory of source (unreadable file fails before any write), per-file reconciliation (existence + size + SHA-256) after copy; optional -ManifestPath JSON (aster-aura.migration-manifest/v1, guard-validated path, no overwrite, relative paths/sizes/hashes only, no file contents)

exitCodes.0: success (DryRun plan valid / Apply copied and reconciled)
exitCodes.2: operation failure (inventory build / robocopy / reconciliation / port rewrite / manifest write)
exitCodes.4: ambiguity refusal (source-dest overlap / non-empty dest / manifest path exists - before any write)

dataMigration.verificationBoundary: automation verifies with synthetic directories only (TEMP sandbox, fabricated data); Apply against real user data is an explicit operator action and is never part of agent verification

notes: FDD layout guard: bundle refuses output containing app-local hostfxr/hostpolicy/coreclr/System.Private.CoreLib (mixed-layout startup failure, see team task t8).
Smoke runs use isolated AURACHAT_HOME/AURACHAT_DATA_DIR inside the bundle output directory; real user data is never touched.
Output directories inside the repository, the user profile, system directories, drive roots or any junction/symlink chain are refused before any write.

Data migration entry (tools/migrate-legacy.ps1) requires explicit -Source/-Dest, defaults to DryRun, and copies only with explicit -Apply; real user data is read only when the operator explicitly targets it in Apply mode, and agent verification uses synthetic directories exclusively.
